Model3DGenerate.multiViewHint: Renders back / left / right as temporary inputs only. They are not saved to the asset library.
Model3DGenerate.multiViewApiKeyMissing: This multi-view model needs a matching API key first. You can also upload back, left, and right views manually.
Model3DGenerate.multiViewUnsupportedHint: Multi-view input is available for Hunyuan3D v3 / v3.1 Pro.
Model3DGenerate.multiViewPickHint: The final run submits the front image and these side views together.
Model3DGenerate.presetFidelityHint: Flux Kontext + PBR + 500k faces. The best starting point for most scenes — 500k stays sharper than 1.5M.
Model3DGenerate.presetDetailHint: Flux Kontext + PBR + 1M faces. Worth it for texture-heavy or industrial subjects.
Model3DGenerate.presetFastHint: Flux Kontext + PBR off + 500k faces. Cheaper and faster — use for iteration only.
Model3DGenerate.retrySeedHint: Reuses the existing multi-view set and only re-runs 3D with a fresh seed (~30s, doesn't regenerate side views).
Model3DGenerate.provisionalSavingLabel: Rendered — saving to your asset library
Model3DGenerate.provisionalSavingHint: The download button activates once saving completes.
Model3DGenerate.stagedModeHint: Preview the geometry before paying for textures. You can retry the shape first if needed.
Model3DGenerate.stageMeshReadyHint: Check proportions, silhouette, and pose. Continuing to texture takes ~90s more.
Model3DGenerate.continueToTextureHint: Generate the full model with textures and PBR materials. Takes about 90 seconds.
Model3DGenerate.diagnoseSilhouetteSuggestion: Regenerate side views first, then reroll mesh
Model3DGenerate.diagnoseProportionsSuggestion: Try a different source image to improve the shape.
Model3DGenerate.diagnoseFacesSuggestion: Increase the face count and regenerate the mesh.
Model3DGenerate.diagnoseUnknownSuggestion: Reroll with a fresh random seed
Model3DGenerate.cancel3DConfirm: Abandon this 3D run? The current geometry will be lost.
Model3DGenerate.rodinTierHint: Higher tiers produce denser geometry and finer detail at the cost of longer generation time.
Model3DGenerate.rodinMeshModeHint: Choose a polygon count and topology. Triangle (Raw) keeps a denser mesh; Quad is retopologized for animation.
Model3DGenerate.rodinTextureModeHint: Higher values produce sharper textures; legacy keeps the older pipeline.
Model3DGenerate.rodinHighPackHint: Doubles polygon count for extreme detail. Adds 1 credit on top of tier cost.
Model3DGenerate.rodinGeometryInstructModeHint: Faithful sticks closely to the reference image; Creative lets the model interpret the silhouette.
Model3DGenerate.rodinTAPoseHint: Optimize mesh topology for humanoid characters in T or A pose.
Model3DGenerate.rodinTextureDelightHint: Remove baked environmental lighting from the texture for cleaner PBR workflow.
Model3DGenerate.rodinIsMicroHint: Only takes effect on the Gen-2.5-Extreme-High tier.
Model3DGenerate.rodinPromptPlaceholder: Optional natural-language guidance for the model…
Model3DGenerate.rodinQualityOverrideHint: Set a specific polygon target. Leave empty to use the tier default.
Model3DGenerate.rodinAdditionalImagesHint: Up to 4 additional views (combined with the source image = 5 total). More views reduce geometric ambiguity.

Model3DGenerate.rodinMeshFirstHint: Generate an untextured mesh first (faster, cheaper). After it lands you can decide whether to spend a second job on textures. Note: textured pass re-runs the model, so the final mesh may differ slightly.
